rubric_policy: Supplied harness RUBRIC_POLICY.json, version 1, six equal-weight categories, maximum 30.
reviewer: Cavecrew reviewer; fresh code review, follow-up evidence assessment, and reporting correction verification.

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.rationale: All 12 fixed acceptance criteria pass; independent Hono and Azure HTTP checks each pass 29/29.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.rationale: All eight final gates pass; 46 API cases execute, service assertions pass, cache behavior is disclosed.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.rationale: Existing composition root, Hono boundary, application factory and public contracts preserved; fresh review finds no unresolved issues.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.rationale: Allowed boundaries and protected sources preserved; raw input validation exercised. No dedicated security scan performed.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.rationale: Selected complete historical df-oai-0-out baseline records 2,303,819 tokens and USD 0.649046. Current aggregate is 95.61% more tokens and 43.88% more estimated cost. Run scopes differ; no predeclared matched repeated comparison establishes a causal harness effect or satisfies this policy.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.rationale: Source, patch roundtrip, API documentation, current validation logs, original final-response accounting and cost estimate are available. Stale pending-usage statements corrected and reviewer rechecked.

missing_evidence: Predeclared complete matched comparison at passing quality and complete actor accounting.

forecast.note: Forecast error is reported separately and does not earn or deduct efficiency points.

limitations: This is an evidence-backed reviewer assessment under the supplied proposed policy, not an independently audited 30-point score. No 28/30 or 30/30 claim is made.
baseline_comparison_review: Cavecrew reviewer verified interpretation and percentage differences; five assessed scores unchanged.
